1. Dietary plant-fiber fermentation is a luminal stool process; oral (34.6% Dec) & mucosa (37.5%) diverge.
2. Epithelial inflammation & slow transit leak O₂/NO₃⁻ (McNemar OR = 1.48; stool 1.95) and raise osmolarity.
3. Result: 14 core fiber/butyrate taxa collapse across PD, HIV & CRC (50.6% Jaccard) as aerotolerants bloom.

Shared Fiber-Guild Loss Appears in Stool (73.0%, p = 1.4×10⁻⁶), Not in Mucosa or Mouth

Cellulose-degrading bacteria decrease in 73.0% of PD+CRC+HIV stool contrasts (81 / 111; 63.7% across all 496 Tier 1+2 stool contrasts, p = 1.1×10⁻⁹), whereas colonic mucosa (37.5%) and oral cavity (34.6%) do not.
